description: This file defines the AuthorizeResponse class, which processes and interprets responses from the Authorize.Net payment gateway, including parsing response fields, checking approval status, and providing access to transaction details.

classes.name: AuthorizeResponse
classes.description: A class that encapsulates and processes the response from the Authorize.Net payment gateway, providing methods to access response details and determine approval status.

classes.name: AuthorizeResponse.RespPositions
classes.description: An abstract static inner class defining methods to get position of response fields and the approval string.

methods.name: AuthorizeResponse
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the response object with a response string and response type.

methods.name: isApproved
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates an approved transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionId
methods.description: Returns the transaction ID from the response.

methods.name: getAuthorizationCode
methods.description: Returns the authorization code from the response.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the transaction amount as BigDecimal.

methods.name: getResponseField
methods.description: Retrieves a response field value by field name or position.
